# nomatron_oidc_group_mapping (Resource)

Nomatron OIDC external-group to RBAC role mapping resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_oidc_group_mapping" "engineering_root" {
  provider_slug  = nomatron_oidc_provider.google.slug
  external_group = "Engineering"
  role           = "root"
  domain         = "global"
  description    = "Engineering group from Google Workspace"
  enabled        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) RBAC domain, for example global or an organization domain.
- `external_group` (String) External OIDC group claim value.
- `provider_slug` (String) OIDC provider slug that owns this mapping.
- `role` (String) Nomatron role name assigned to matching users.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Mapping description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this mapping is active.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the mapping was created.
- `id` (String) OIDC group mapping ID.
- `provider_id` (String) OIDC provider ID.
